#PHP Tips and tricks
PHP tips and tricks is a treasure trove of PHP pieces of code. It collects all those quick one-liners, unexpected behaviors, hidden features and strange things that are concealed in the dark corners of PHP.

##Entries
[strtr() Does Only One Pass](https://php-tips.readthedocs.io/en/latest/tips/strtr.html) strtr() replaces string inside a string, just like str_replace().
[explode() negative third argument](https://php-tips.readthedocs.io/en/latest/tips/explode_third_arg.html) The third argument of explode() is a hidden gem.
[Interface Implemented Too Low](https://php-tips.readthedocs.io/en/latest/tips/interface_too_low.html) An interface's signatures applies only to the current class and its children.
[What Array Is A List](https://php-tips.readthedocs.io/en/latest/tips/what_array_list.html) array_is_list() was introduced in PHP 8.
[Closure::getCurrent() To Reach The Closure](https://php-tips.readthedocs.io/en/latest/tips/closure_getcurrent.html) I was happy to see PHP add ``Closure::getCurrent()``.
[A Non-transitive Comparison](https://php-tips.readthedocs.io/en/latest/tips/non-transitive-comparison.html) Sometimes I truly believe that I have grasped all of the weird semantics of PHP, and then I discover something so simple that breaks an assumption I had about the language.
[Chained Assignation Skips __get()](https://php-tips.readthedocs.io/en/latest/tips/chained_assignation.html) Chained assignation skip the ``get`` part and assign the same value to all elements in the chain.
[eval() And __FILE__](https://php-tips.readthedocs.io/en/latest/tips/eval_and__FILE__.html) __FILE__ is a magic constant that holds the current file full path.
[Fiber Throws Where The Fiber Is](https://php-tips.readthedocs.io/en/latest/tips/fiber-throw-suspension.html) ``Fiber`` is the generator's sibling that nobody writes tips about, so here is one.
[Infinite Operations](https://php-tips.readthedocs.io/en/latest/tips/infinite_operations.html) Here are some border line calculations with large numbers in PHP: calculating beyond PHP_INT_MAX is possible, as long as the resulting number is still.

[The Unreachable Method](https://php-tips.readthedocs.io/en/latest/tips/unreachable_method.html) How can one call the A::foo() method? A::foo() is public, but it is also part of an abstract class.
[min() And max() For Interval](https://php-tips.readthedocs.io/en/latest/tips/min-max.html) PHP trick: min-max a number in one line.
[Extra ::class](https://php-tips.readthedocs.io/en/latest/tips/extra_class.html) It is possible to use ``::class`` when reaching for static elements with the ``::`` operator: the ``::class`` returns the full name of the class, which is later used to look for the static.
[Other Types For A Property](https://php-tips.readthedocs.io/en/latest/tips/other_type_for_property.html) It is possible to make a typed property accept more than its definition type.
[Larger Than Int](https://php-tips.readthedocs.io/en/latest/tips/larger_than_int.html) printf() displays an integer as a string.
[Duplicate Type](https://php-tips.readthedocs.io/en/latest/tips/duplicate_type.html) Union types check for duplicate types, so ``array|array`` is not possible, nor if a class is aliased with a use expression: on the other hand, it is valid with a class alias, created with ``class_alias()``.
[Yield Or Return](https://php-tips.readthedocs.io/en/latest/tips/yield_or_return.html) It is possible to spread an array as dynamic arguments: this applies to returned arrays, after a function call.

[Cloning Static Variable](https://php-tips.readthedocs.io/en/latest/tips/cloning_static_variable.html) It is not possible to clone a static variable, but it is well possible to duplicate a closure which contains a static variable.
